description: A segmented non-ARQ C_PDU to a group address sets GROUP ADDRESS on every D_PDU, and its repeats follow all the first copies.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and sends "group-message" (13 bytes, priority 0, TTL 0) to group address 0.0.1.9 with Minimum Number of Retransmissions 1, so each D_PDU is sent twice (A-0081, A-0083, C-0848). The 19-byte C_PDU is cut into segments of 10 and 9 bytes (dts.max_segment_size 10), C_PDU ID 0, offsets 0 and 10 (C-0527, C-0529). Every D_PDU has GROUP ADDRESS 1 and the group as its destination (C-0122, C-0338, C-0339). Spreading (C-0885, C-1055): the repeat copies go after all the first copies, one round at a time, so the order is segment 0, segment 1, segment 0, segment 1, and each copy is as far as it can be from its twin. All four fit one 256-byte block: EOT and reception window 10 each (duration 5550 ms).
